Project Features:

A modern residential development in Business Bay, ONDA by KASCO combines contemporary architecture, wellness-inspired spaces, and everyday convenience.

About the Community :-

Business Bay is a vibrant district in the heart of Dubai, centered around the Dubai Canal. Known for its modern residential towers and waterfront living, it offers stunning city and canal views with easy access to Downtown Dubai and major attractions.

Proximity :

It’s only 7 minutes drive to The Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa, 15 Minutes to Jumeirah Beach and 20 minutes to Dubai International Airport (DXB) so you don’t have to worry as you are close to all the Dubai iconic destinations!
